title: STAR: SocioTechnical Approach to Red Teaming Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Instructing human red teamers with parameterised prompts to elicit hate speech and discriminatory stereotypes against specific racial/ethnic groups (e.g., Asian, Black, Hispanic, White), with model outputs evaluated by demographically matched annotators.

Instructing human red teamers with parameterised prompts to elicit hate speech and discriminatory stereotypes against specific gender groups (e.g., Female, Male, Non-binary), with model outputs evaluated by demographically matched annotators.

Conducting human red teaming attacks targeting race-by-gender intersectionalities (e.g., women of color) and using statistical testing on the resulting dialogues to measure the compounding likelihood of the model producing intersectional stereotypes and hate speech.
